transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough, mainly. It just won't go away and it's getting me down a bit.
Could you describe when this cough started, how it came on, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It came on a while back, after I'd had a bit of a cold. As for medicines, I don't think I've ever had a bad reaction to any of them.
How much is this cough affecting your day-to-day life?
It's a nuisance, more than I'd expect from a bit of a cough. It's been waking me up at night, that's the worst part.
Can you tell me about any medicines you take regularly, and whether anything new or different has been started recently?
Just my usual inhalers and a tablet for my blood pressure, nothing new.
Have you ever had an operation?
No, I've never had an operation.
Apart from the cough, have you noticed anything else that's been bothering you?
I do seem to get a bit more puffed out than usual when I walk to the shop. No blood or anything like that, though.
Where do you feel the cough most, and does it spread anywhere from there?
It's in my chest, mostly. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere.
Is there anything you've noticed that makes your cough better or worse?
Cold air seems to set it off, and if I'm talking for a long while. Steam helps a little bit.
What worries you most about your cough?
I suppose I worry my lungs are getting worse, or that it could be something like cancer. That's what's been on my mind.
Is there anything else about your past health — like ongoing conditions, past illnesses, or hospital stays — that you’d like to add?
I've got COPD — emphysema, they called it — and I've had that for a good while now. Nothing else springs to mind.
Can you describe what the cough actually feels like when it comes on?
It's a chesty cough — I'm bringing stuff up, more than I usually do in the mornings.
You’ve mentioned getting more puffed out than usual when walking and that there’s no blood in the cough — is there anything else you’ve noticed that you’d like to add?
No, otherwise I feel alright in myself. I've not lost any weight, and I've not had any night sweats or chest pains.
When did this cough first start, and did it come on suddenly or build up gradually — and did anything seem to set it off at the time?
It started about three weeks ago now, and it came on gradually after I'd had a cold. Nothing else seemed to set it off.
On a scale of 0 to 10, how much does the cough get in the way of your usual daily activities, with 0 being not at all and 10 being a great deal?
It gets in the way a fair bit, I'd say. I couldn't really put a number on it, though.
Thinking about your usual day, is the cough something you can mostly carry on through, does it slow you down a bit, or does it stop you doing things you'd normally do — or are you not sure?
It slows me down a bit, and it wakes me most nights — I'd put it at about a 6 out of 10.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
